review_candidates.title: WordPress Website Designer & Developer
review_candidates.description: WordPress Website Designer & Developer BEFORE YOU APPLY This role requires a portfolio and a Loom video. Applications without both will not be reviewed. This is a design role and a build role. Both — not one or the other. We are not looking for someone who waits for a finished Figma file and clicks it together. We are looking for a designer who can take a client's brand kit, a stack of inspiration sites, and a page of approved copy, and create an original, modern, conversion-focused design from a blank canvas — then build it in Bricks Builder themselves. - If you have never designed a website from scratch, this is not your role. - If you design beautiful sites but cannot build them in Bricks, this is not your role. - If you can do both, keep reading. Those people are rare, and we know it. THE BASICS Location: Fully remote, based in Egypt ABOUT US We help small business owners stop wasting money on marketing that does not work and start winning with clear messaging, high-converting websites, and systems that actually grow their business. Our websites are built to do one thing well: turn visitors into leads and customers. We are not a "make it look pretty and hope" agency. We care about strategy, clarity, performance, and results. We are adding a WordPress Website Designer & Developer who shares that mindset and has a sharp eye for clean, conversion-focused design. WHAT THE JOB ACTUALLY LOOKS LIKE You own client websites end to end — from the first blank artboard to the live, fast, fully integrated site. A typical project runs like this: 1. The client sends their branding assets and 2 to 5 inspiration websites with notes on what they like. 2. Our strategy team delivers the message, the page structure, and all of the copy. 3. From there it is yours. You decide the layout, the visual system, the typography, the spacing, the imagery, the motion, and how every section looks and feels. 4. You build the whole thing in WordPress using Bricks Builder and make it work flawlessly on desktop, tablet, and mobile. You are not decorating a template. You are designing something original for that specific business, then building it yourself so nothing gets lost in translation. Alongside new builds, you keep existing client sites fast, secure, and stable. RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Original Design — the part we care most about - Create original website designs from scratch for each client, based on their brand, industry, audience, and inspiration references. - Make real design decisions: layout, hierarchy, typography, color application, spacing, imagery direction, and interaction. - Treat inspiration references as direction, not as something to copy. Clients should get something that feels made for them. - Design custom assets as needed — icons, graphics, banners, illustrations, section visuals — in Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or your tool of choice. - Present and explain your design decisions clearly to the internal team and, when needed, to the client. 2. Build — WordPress and Bricks Builder - Build every design you create in WordPress using Bricks Builder, at an expert level. - Translate approved strategy and copy into clean, conversion-focused layouts that hold up on desktop, tablet, and mobile. - Rebuild sites made in other builders and migrate them to Bricks. - Create and manage staging and testing environments for new sites and major updates. - Keep builds clean, organized, reusable, and easy for the next person to work in. 3. Maintenance and Optimization - Update and maintain existing client WordPress and Bricks sites. - Manage plugins responsibly: updates, replacements, and removal of outdated or broken plugins. - Audit sites for technical issues — broken forms, bad code, outdated plugins, performance problems. - Hold the line on site speed, security, backups, and overall stability. 4. Hosting, Migrations, and Launches - Move WordPress sites between hosting providers safely and correctly. - Work confidently with hosting environments and basic server considerations. - Connect domains, manage DNS changes, and run smooth site launches. 5. Integrations and Tracking - Integrate WordPress sites with third-party tools using platforms like Zapier. - Set up and manage Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics. - Make sure every form and lead capture tool is properly connected and tested. 6. Communication and Collaboration - Communicate clearly and proactively with the internal team. - Ask smart questions when something is unclear instead of guessing. - Give realistic timelines and honest progress updates. - Take feedback well and use it to make the final product better. WHAT YOU NEED (must-have) Design - Proven experience designing websites from scratch, not just building from someone else's design. Your portfolio must show sites where you made the design decisions. - Strong eye for layout, spacing, typography, and visual hierarchy. - Ability to follow branding guidelines and inspiration while still making smart, original design decisions. - Solid understanding of responsive and mobile-first design. - Working knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator, or Figma. Build and technical - Expert-level experience with WordPress and Bricks Builder. - Experience maintaining WordPress sites and managing plugins safely. - Experience migrating WordPress sites between hosts. - Ability to audit and troubleshoot WordPress issues. - Comfortable integrating third-party tools and tracking systems. Communication - Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. NICE TO HAVE - Familiarity with GoHighLevel (big plus). - Experience embedding or integrating GoHighLevel tools into WordPress sites (huge plus). - Experience working with marketing agencies or service-based businesses. - Real understanding of conversion-focused design, not just aesthetics. - Basic understanding of SEO-friendly site structure. - Comfort with light custom CSS or JavaScript when Bricks alone will not get there. HOW TO APPLY Send the following to abdelrahmanmofeed@virtualworkernow.com. Applications missing either item will not be reviewed. 1. Portfolio — showing sites where you made the design decisions yourself, not just the build. Note which ones you designed from scratch and which you built in Bricks. 2. Loom video — walk through one project from the portfolio and explain your design decisions: why that layout, that type, that hierarchy, and how you got from the client's inspiration references to something original.

review_candidates.description: Position Summary The Medical Device Technician is a full-time member of the Information Technology (IT) Team responsible for supporting medical devices, telehealth technology, Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), retinal screening technology, tablets, and other digital health tools used to support patient care and access to services. The position works closely with IT staff, providers, clinical teams, and patients to ensure technology is properly deployed, functional, secure, and effectively incorporated into clinical workflows. The Medical Device Technician provides technical assistance and training but does not perform clinical functions or supervise employees. Major Areas of Responsibility Medical Device and Equipment Support Configure, deploy, maintain, inventory, and troubleshoot medical devices and related technology. Support smart blood pressure monitors, glucose monitoring devices, weight scales, portable digital retinal cameras, tablets, and other digital health equipment. Coordinate equipment repairs, replacements, warranty services, and vendor support as needed. Maintain accurate equipment and deployment records. Remote Patient Monitoring Support implementation and ongoing operation of the organization’s RPM program. Assist staff and patients with device setup, connectivity, data transmission, and troubleshooting. Identify and resolve technical barriers that affect patient participation in RPM. Escalate clinical concerns to appropriate clinical personnel. Telehealth Support Provide technical assistance to providers, staff, and patients before and during telehealth visits. Support tablets, cameras, microphones, speakers, internet connections, and telehealth applications. Troubleshoot common audio, video, connectivity, and access issues. Assist patients with basic use of telehealth technology. Patient Registration and Screening Technology Assist patients with tablet-based registration, electronic intake, consent processes, and other digital check-in activities. Provide technical support for electronic patient screening tools and questionnaires. Prepare, maintain, secure, and troubleshoot tablets used for patient services. Assist clinical staff with incorporating digital screening tools into patient workflows. Translation and Interpretation Technology Assist providers and patients with approved electronic translation and interpretation services. Support technology connections with interpreters during telehealth and in-person encounters. Troubleshoot routine device, audio, video, connectivity, and access issues affecting translation services. Retinal Screening Technology Support deployment, setup, maintenance, and troubleshooting of portable digital retinal imaging equipment. Assist staff with equipment connectivity, image transmission, and related software. Help integrate retinal screening technology into clinical workflows. Training and Technical Assistance Provide hands-on technical training to staff and patients on supported devices and digital health technologies. Develop or assist with user-friendly technical instructions and reference materials. Provide follow-up assistance and troubleshooting to users experiencing technology difficulties. Maintain a professional, patient-centered approach when providing technical support. IT Systems and Security Work collaboratively with the IT Team to integrate medical devices and digital health technologies into the organization's technology environment. Assist with device configuration, software access, connectivity, user access, and technology testing. Follow organizational requirements for HIPAA, privacy, cybersecurity, device security, and appropriate use of technology. Escalate complex technical, network, software, or cybersecurity issues to appropriate IT personnel or vendors. Documentation, Quality Improvement, and Grant Support Maintain documentation related to equipment, deployment, training, troubleshooting, and technical support. Assist with tracking technology-related activities and performance measures. Identify recurring technical issues and recommend improvements. Support grant reporting, quality improvement activities, technology implementation projects, and related initiatives. Collaboration and Reporting The Medical Device Technician reports to the Facilities and Special Projects Director and functions as a member of the IT Team. The position collaborates with providers, nurses, care coordinators, population health staff, clinical quality personnel, patients, and administrative staff. This is a non-supervisory position. No employees report to the Medical Device Technician. Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent required. Experience in IT support, medical device support, healthcare technology, or a related field preferred. Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Ability to learn and support medical devices, tablets, software applications, telehealth platforms, and connectivity technologies. Strong communication and customer-service skills, including the ability to explain technology clearly to patients and staff. Ability to work independently and collaboratively with clinical and IT teams. Ability to maintain confidentiality and follow HIPAA, cybersecurity, and organizational privacy requirements. Preferred: Associate degree, technical certification, or relevant coursework in Information Technology, Biomedical Equipment Technology, Healthcare Technology, Electronics, Computer Science, or a related field; experience with Remote Patient Monitoring, telehealth, retinal screening, electronic registration, patient screening tools, or healthcare technology. review_candidates.title: Incident Support Engineer (Automotive background)
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Incident Support Engineer (Automotive background) Work Location : Irvine, CA (Onsite) Contract duration: 12+ months Contract Job type: Contract Role Summary We are seeking Support Engineer role for a 24/7 Incident Management (IM) operations program supporting a key player in the automotive industry's connected car space. This role will primarily focus on monitoring the system health using different data monitoring tools such as Datadog, Grafana, MaxGauge, Elastic, Dynatrace. Once an anomaly or unusual pattern is observed, escalate it to the respective teams, initiate an incident bridge, driving the bridge, taking incident timeline, facilitate the teams to bring an ongoing incident to closure and ensuring adherence to contractual SLAs. The IM Support Engineer will orchestrate end-to-end incident handling—from anomaly detection to bridge initiation, stakeholder communications, resolution, and post-incident governance—with a strong background in Telematics and Connected Vehicle systems (including Remote Services). Key Responsibilities · Monitor the health and availability of production systems supporting the Connected Car / Telematics ecosystem. · Proactively monitor application, infrastructure, API, database, and service health using tools such as: · Datadog · Grafana · MaxGauge · Application and system logs · Organization-specific monitoring and observability tools · Identify abnormal system behavior, performance degradation, errors, latency, service failures, and potential outages. · Analyze dashboards, alerts, metrics, logs, and application behavior to identify the initial scope and impact of incidents. · Perform proactive monitoring to identify issues before they impact customers. · Validate alerts and distinguish between genuine production incidents and false positives/noise. · Adhere to the IM SLAs (MTTD, MTTA, MTTR, communication SLAs); ensure measurement, reporting, and continuous improvement. · Should be proficient in handling the incidents ranging from high priority ones (P1, P2) to the low priority incidents (P3, P4). · Initiate and run incident bridges/war rooms; coordinate cross-functional responders (application, infrastructure, network, OEM partners, and third parties). · Oversee proactive detection through data monitoring tools (Datadog, Dynatrace, Grafana, MaxGauge) and ensure alert quality, runbooks, and signal-to-noise optimization. · Establish and enforce SOPs for incident declaration, severity classification, response roles and decision logs. · Drive disciplined stakeholder communications: timely updates to product, operations, OEM/customer contacts, leadership, and impacted regions; maintain comms cadence and channels. · Ensure post-incident governance: facilitate RCA, document contributing causes, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and circulate the RCA across teams for sign-off. · Define and maintain IM dashboards, KPIs, and executive reports; present weekly/monthly service reviews with trend analysis and action plans. · Collaborate with Product/Engineering to influence reliability roadmaps (resiliency patterns, observability, capacity, release safeguards). · Ensure compliance with information security, data privacy, and OEM contractual obligations during incident handling and communications. · Continuously refine IM playbooks, runbooks, and training; conduct simulations/game days and readiness audits across onsite–offshore teams. Domain Expertise: Telematics & Connected Car · Hands-on knowledge of Telematics Control Unit (TCU), eSIM/OTA provisioning, backend telematics platforms, and data flows between vehicle, cloud, and mobile apps. · Understanding on Internet of Things including but not limited to Messaging Queues, bulk provisioning, notification systems, API Gateways, Load Balancers, Mobile applications & web applications. · Familiarity with Remote Services (e.g., remote lock/unlock, start/stop, charge control, climate pre-conditioning), geo-services, and safety/assist features. · Understanding of service dependencies: identity/auth, messaging, device management, CAN bus signals, firmware/OTA update orchestration, and regional compliance. · Experience coordinating incidents across OEM partners, Tier-1 suppliers, cloud providers, and customer support operations. Required Qualifications · 5+ years in Operations/Service Management with 4+ years leading Incident Management in large-scale, 24/7 environments. · Demonstrated experience running bridges for P1/P0 incidents; proven incident commander skills and decision-making under pressure. · Strong background in Telematics/Connected Car domain and vehicle remote services concepts. · Proficiency with observability and monitoring tools: Dynatrace, Datadog, Grafana, MaxGauge (dashboards, alerting, traces, logs). · Expertise in IM processes: detection → triage → severity assignment → bridge initiation → stakeholder updates → resolution → post-incident RCA. · Working knowledge of ITIL practices (Incident, Problem, Change, Service Level Management). · Should have good hands on experience in using tools like JIRA, Confluence, Jenkins, XMatters. · Excellent communication (written/verbal), executive presence, and stakeholder management across onsite–offshore teams. · Ability to analyze telemetry and time-series data to drive root cause hypotheses and corrective actions. · Experience defining SLAs/SLOs and building KPI dashboards (MTTD/MTTA/MTTR, incident volume, recurrence, comms SLA, customer impact). Tools & Technologies · Datadog, Dynatrace , Grafana, MaxGauge (APM, logs, metrics, dashboards). · Incident & Comms: ticketing (Jira/ServiceNow), chat/bridge tools (Teams/Zoom), status pages. · Data: time-series analysis, log aggregation, tracing, alerting policies and noise reduction.

review_candidates.description: Hertfordshire Constabulary Police Staff Permanent Full Time ICT Headquarters, Huntingdon, Cambs , Headquarters, WGC, Herts A4 £32,613 37 A great opportunity has arisen to join a growing support team as an ICT Senior Service Desk Analyst within the BCH (Beds, Cambs & Herts) ICT Department. Join the exciting and dynamic world of policing and contribute towards making Bedfordshire, Cambridgeshire and Hertfordshire a safer place. Based at Hertfordshire Constabulary HQ or Cambridgeshire Constabulary, you will play a key role within the ICT Operations Team, supporting the tri-force ICT estate and ensuring that vital business systems remain highly available to officers and staff. About The Role As a Senior Service Desk Analyst, you will provide first-line ICT support while also taking on additional responsibility for supporting and guiding a team of five analysts. You will act as an escalation point for more complex or non-standard issues, helping to drive service quality and improve first-time fix rates. You will use your technical knowledge and customer service skills to diagnose hardware, software and communication issues reported via phone or self-service. Where resolution is not possible at first contact, you will ensure incidents are accurately logged, fully documented, and escalated within agreed SLAs, maintaining clear communication with users throughout. You will also contribute to continuous improvement by maintaining knowledge base articles and coaching the development of colleagues across the Service Desk. Why Join BCH ICT? Bedfordshire, Cambridgeshire and Hertfordshire Police form one of the largest and most established collaborations in the UK. This role offers a fantastic opportunity to develop your career within a supportive and forward-thinking ICT environment, with exposure to a diverse technology estate and opportunities to build leadership experience. Employee Benefits 25 days annual leave, rising to 29 after 5 years’ service (plus public holidays) Competitive Local Government Pension Scheme Access to on-site gym facilities at HQ locations Hybrid working arrangements Blue Light Card discounts Sports and social club membership Employee Assistance Programme Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Everyone at Bedfordshire, Cambridgeshire and Hertfordshire takes personal responsibility to help create an inclusive workplace, where police officers and staff respect one another, feel valued for their differences and can be themselves. We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments, wherever needed so everyone feels welcome and can flourish. We are working hard to continue to enhance and increase our diversity across the three forces, where communities are under-represented, including those from Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic communities, people of all ages, abilities, faiths, religions and gender, LGBT communities and those from other disadvantaged or marginalised backgrounds, who share our values and wish to make a difference to the communities we serve. All applications will be treated on merit, based on the evidence provided in your application and your suitability for the role for which you have applied. We are a Disability Confident employer offering a guaranteed interview scheme for all candidates with a disability covered by the Equality Act 2010 who meet the minimum entry requirements. Should you require any reasonable adjustments for your application process, please contact the HR Recruitment Centre on 01438 757 777. Flexible Working BCH supports agile and flexible working wherever possible. All requests will be considered in line with operational requirements. Police Barred and Advisory lists Individuals placed on the Police Barred and Advisory lists will not be considered for employment by the police for a minimum of 5 years from the date of listing in the case of gross misconduct, or 3 years from the date of listing in the case of poor performance. Vetting and Safeguarding BCH are committed to safeguarding and operate safer recruitment processes, to ensure a police service that employees are proud to work for because they feel safe, valued and part of a happy and supportive work environment. All employees and volunteers therefore will be subject to background checks including vetting and references. Please be aware the Police Corporate Vetting Unit will undertake security vetting on successful candidates, their family and others that live at their home address, which will include financial checks. How To Apply If you are successful, you will be joining one of the most accomplished policing collaborations in the UK where our vision for the future of BCH Policing is exhibited daily across the full breadth of capabilities and functions we deliver. Please Submit Your CV Along With Evidence of your relevant skills and experience A 500-word statement demonstrating how you meet the minimum entry requirements For further information, please contact Jamie Read (BCH Operations, ICT Service Desk Team Leader) via Jamie.Read@cambs.police.uk Additional Advert Information Internal Applicants To apply for this role, internal applicants must have successfully completed their probationary period. If you qualify as an internal candidate within the advertising force, you may upload either your CV or the internal role summary form attached to this advert. Vetting Process Please note that, as part of the vetting process, the BCH Vetting Unit may need to contact your current line manager for a Supervisor Appraisal. This requirement aligns with the 2025 National Guidelines for Vetting (APP 6.5.18). Examples Of When This May Apply Include Transferring to another force Renewing vetting clearance Moving into a role requiring MV clearance (even if you currently hold MV clearance) Moving into or working in a role involving close contact with vulnerable individuals If any of the above apply to you, please expect your line manager to be contacted when you submit your vetting application. Redeployment and Redundancy This vacancy is open to employees at risk of redundancy and will remain available to redeployees until a final offer has been agreed and accepted. Redeployees at risk of redundancy will take priority over all other applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. If successful, redeployees will remain on their home force’s terms and conditions. Role Profile We recommend downloading and saving a copy of the role profile, as it will no longer be accessible once the advert closes. Unser Unternehmen ist geprägt von flacher Hierarchie, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem familiären Betriebsklima. Wie Dein Tag aussieht Du analysierst und behebst komplexe Fehler und übernimmst anspruchsvolle 3rd-Level-Support-Fälle. Du analysierst Datenbankzustände, Logs und Konfigurationen, reproduzierst Fehler und findest Workarounds. Du arbeitest direkt mit Entwicklung und Produktmanagement zusammen und bringst Softwareverbesserungen aus der Praxis ein. Du betreust unsere Kunden im Gesundheitswesen mit komplexen Prozessen durch dein hohes Fachwissen. Du hilfst die Wissensdatenbank aktuell zu halten und gestaltest Prozesse und Tools im Support. Wichtig: Dein Fokus liegt auf Analyse, technische Fehlerklärung und nachhaltige Problemlösung. Es ist kein Telefon-Hotline Support. Was Du mitbringen solltest Du bringst mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im technischen Software-Support, Applikation-Support oder Systemanalyse mit Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung Prozessen und den gängigen Schnittstellen im Gesundheitswesen. Du hast Erfahrung in der Fehleranalyse von technischen REST, SOAP und Filebasierten Schnittstellen. Du hast sehr gute Kenntnisse in Oracle SQL/PLSQL, Datenprüfung und bringst ein Performance-Grundverständnis mit. Du gehst analytisch, systematisch und lösungsorientiert vor und organisierst Deine Arbeit eigenständig. Du verfügst über Verständnis von 3-Tier-Architekturen (Frontend, Backend, Datenbank) und idealerweise Grundlagen in objektorientierter Programmierung. Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine Ausbildung im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Du beherrschst Deutsch fliessend in Wort und Schrift und hast die Fähigkeit, mit Kunden und Entwicklern präzise zu kommunizieren. Was wir bieten Das Arbeiten bei uns ist spannend und vielseitig. Wir sind in kleinen, interdisziplinären Teams organisiert, die Dich unterstützen, motivieren und herausfordern. Wir sind familienfreundlich, Home-Office und Teilzeitarbeit sind bei uns selbstverständlich. Weiterbildung? Klar, wir unterstützen den Fortbildungswillen unserer Mitarbeitenden. Zudem setzen wir auf Nachhaltigkeit und fahren lieber Zug als Auto. Wenn Du Neugierde, Einsatzbereitschaft und Offenheit mitbringst und gerne die kreative Lösungssuche förderst, bist Du bei uns richtig. Sende uns Deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf und Motivationsschreiben an jobs@tie.ch. Wir freuen uns Dich kennenzulernen.
